name: Basic Applied Mathematics
description: Applied mathematics for Tanzanian A-Level students covering algebra, calculus, matrices, statistics, probability, vectors, and real-world problem solving across Form V and Form VI.

subtopics.title: Set notation and Venn diagrams
outcomes: Define sets using roster and set-builder notation
Interpret Venn diagrams with up to three sets
Solve problems involving union, intersection and complement of sets

subtopics.title: Laws of set algebra
outcomes: State commutative, associative and distributive laws of sets
Verify set identities using Venn diagrams
Apply De Morgan's laws to simplify set expressions

subtopics.title: Sets and subsets
outcomes: Define universal set, empty set, subset and power set
Determine the number of elements in a power set

subtopics.title: Introduction to logic
outcomes: Define statement, truth value, negation, conjunction and disjunction
Construct truth tables for compound statements
Determine the validity of logical arguments using truth tables

subtopics.title: Polynomials
outcomes: Define polynomial, degree, coefficient and constant term
Perform addition, subtraction and multiplication of polynomials
Divide polynomials using long division and synthetic division

subtopics.title: Factor and remainder theorems
outcomes: State the factor theorem and the remainder theorem
Use the factor theorem to factorise cubic polynomials
Find unknown constants in polynomials given factors

subtopics.title: Partial fractions
outcomes: Resolve proper algebraic fractions into partial fractions
Resolve fractions with repeated and quadratic factors

subtopics.title: Simultaneous equations
outcomes: Solve simultaneous linear equations in two unknowns
Solve one linear and one quadratic equation simultaneously
Interpret solutions of simultaneous equations graphically

subtopics.title: Inequalities
outcomes: Solve linear inequalities in one variable
Solve quadratic inequalities using sign diagrams
Represent solutions of inequalities on a number line

subtopics.title: Functions, domain and range
outcomes: Define function, domain, codomain and range
Determine domain and range from equations, graphs and tables
Classify relations as functions or non-functions

subtopics.title: Types of functions
outcomes: Identify linear, quadratic, polynomial, rational, exponential and logarithmic functions
Match real-world situations to appropriate function types

subtopics.title: Composite functions
outcomes: Form composite functions from two or more given functions
Determine the domain of composite functions

subtopics.title: Inverse functions
outcomes: Determine whether a function is one-to-one using the horizontal line test
Find the inverse of a given function
Sketch the graph of an inverse function as a reflection in y equals x

subtopics.title: Transformations of graphs
outcomes: Describe translations, reflections and stretches of graphs
Apply transformations to sketch graphs of related functions

subtopics.title: Arithmetic progressions
outcomes: Define arithmetic progression, first term and common difference
Derive and apply the formula for the nth term
Derive and apply the formula for the sum of the first n terms

subtopics.title: Geometric progressions
outcomes: Define geometric progression and common ratio
Find the nth term and the sum of the first n terms of a GP
Determine convergence and find the sum to infinity of a GP

subtopics.title: Sigma notation and summation
outcomes: Use sigma notation to express sums

subtopics.title: Applications of sequences and series
outcomes: Solve real-life problems involving arithmetic and geometric sequences
Model compound interest and depreciation using geometric sequences

subtopics.title: Definition and types of matrices
outcomes: Define a matrix and classify matrices by order and type
Identify row, column, square, identity and zero matrices

subtopics.title: Operations on matrices
outcomes: Multiply a matrix by a scalar
Verify properties of matrix arithmetic such as associativity and distributivity

subtopics.title: Determinants of 2 by 2 and 3 by 3 matrices
outcomes: Calculate the determinant of a 2 by 2 matrix
Calculate the determinant of a 3 by 3 matrix by cofactor expansion
Use determinants to test for singular and non-singular matrices

subtopics.title: Inverse of a matrix
outcomes: Find the inverse of a 2 by 2 matrix using the adjoint method
Find the inverse of a 3 by 3 matrix
Use matrix inverses to solve systems of linear equations

subtopics.title: Solving simultaneous equations using matrices
outcomes: Express a system of linear equations in matrix form
Solve systems of up to three linear equations using the inverse matrix method
Apply Cramer's rule to solve linear systems

subtopics.title: Straight line equations
outcomes: Derive the equation of a straight line given two points
Find the equation of a line given slope and intercept
Determine the angle between two intersecting lines

subtopics.title: Parallel and perpendicular lines
outcomes: State the condition for two lines to be parallel
Find the equation of a line parallel or perpendicular to a given line

subtopics.title: Circles
outcomes: Write the equation of a circle in standard and general form
Find the centre and radius of a circle from its equation
Determine whether a line intersects, touches or misses a circle

subtopics.title: Equation of a parabola
outcomes: Define parabola as a locus of points equidistant from focus and directrix
Sketch a parabola and identify its vertex, focus and directrix

subtopics.title: Ellipse and hyperbola
outcomes: Write the standard equations of an ellipse and a hyperbola
Identify key features including vertices, foci and asymptotes

subtopics.title: Limits of functions
outcomes: Define the limit of a function as x approaches a finite value

Apply the sum, difference and constant multiple rules

subtopics.title: Product, quotient and chain rules
outcomes: Apply the product rule to differentiate products of functions
Apply the quotient rule to differentiate ratios of functions
Apply the chain rule to differentiate composite functions

subtopics.title: Implicit and parametric differentiation
outcomes: Find dy by dx given parametric equations

subtopics.title: Higher derivatives

subtopics.title: Tangents and normals

Find the equation of a normal to a curve at a given point

subtopics.title: Curve sketching

outcomes: Apply the method of substitution to evaluate integrals
Use partial fractions to integrate rational functions

subtopics.title: Definite integrals
outcomes: Evaluate definite integrals using the fundamental theorem of calculus

subtopics.title: Area between curves
outcomes: Find the area between two curves using definite integration

subtopics.title: Numerical integration
outcomes: Apply the trapezium rule to approximate definite integrals

subtopics.title: Measures of central tendency

Select appropriate measures of central tendency for different data sets

subtopics.title: Measures of dispersion
outcomes: Calculate range, variance and standard deviation
Interpret the standard deviation as a measure of spread
Use coefficient of variation to compare variability of data sets

subtopics.title: Cumulative frequency and histograms
outcomes: Construct cumulative frequency tables and ogives

subtopics.title: Correlation and regression

subtopics.title: Mutually exclusive and independent events

subtopics.title: Bayes' theorem

subtopics.title: Linear inequalities and feasible regions
